text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки does well at the Satsuki Sho,
but she's
unsettled by an odd sensation
in her legs after
the race...

She suspects it has something to do with
her
distance aptitude, so she enlists the
help of
Агнес Тахион to test out her
hypothesis.

Their findings reveal that Фудзи Кисэки
really is more
suited to mile-long races
than medium-length
races.

The next day, she reports her discovery
to me.
The Japanese Derby and Kikuka
Sho are longer
races, but she relishes the
challenge of running
them.

I'm torn between whether she should
continue the
Classic Triple Crown tour
despite the difficulty, or
switch to the
mile tour, which would allow her to
run
at her very best...
